question: **Select the most appropriate option for blank no. 8.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **countries**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meanings of the given words.

 
 
• **County **means an area of land with its own people, government, etc.
 
• **Town **means a place where there are a lot of houses, stores, and other buildings which is smaller than a city.
 
• **Village **means a group of houses with other buildings, for example a shop, school, etc. in a country area. A village is smaller than a town.
 
• **State **is a sovereign in its territory (also referred to as jurisdiction) and has the authority to enforce a system of rules over the people living inside it.
 
 
 
• The risk of polio disease in different countries is discussed throughout the passage, So, "**countries**" is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: **All nations continue to be in danger of importing poliovirus**

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.**

Complete passage: *Polio was once a disease feared worldwide, striking suddenly and paralysing mainly children (1) for __life. WHO is a partner in the Global Polio Eradication Initiative, the __(2) largest__ private-public partnership for health, which has __(3) reduced__ polio by 99%. Polio now survives __(4) only __among the world's three poorest and __(5) most__ marginalised communities, where it stalks the most __(6) vulnerable__ children. These are - Afghanistan, Nigeria and Pakistan. __(7)Until__ poliovirus transmission is interrupted in these countries, all **__(8) countries__** remain at risk of importation of polio, (9)________ vulnerable countries with weak public health and immunisation services. WHO's goal is (10)_______ every last child with polio vaccine and ensure a polio-free world for future generations.*
